# Machine Matcher

> > Machine Matcher is a global marketplace and support platform specializing in roll forming machines, offering valuation, technical support, and procurement services for industrial metal fabrication equipment.

Machine Matcher connects buyers and sellers of new and used roll forming machines across North America, Europe, and Asia. The platform provides comprehensive services including machine valuation, 24/7 technical support, maintenance and repair, and a searchable catalog of machines organized by application (roofing, structural framing, decking, renewable energy, and more).

## Key Topics

## Core Services

- [Machine Matcher Homepage](https://machinematcher.com): Roll forming machines marketplace with valuation and support services
- [Roll Forming Machine Valuation & Inspection](https://machinematcher.com/machine-valuation): Remote and on-site roll forming machine valuation using global market data
- [Roll Forming Machine Technical Support](https://machinematcher.com/technical-support-desk): 24/7 global technical support for roll forming machines with remote fault diagnosis
- [Roll Forming Machine Maintenance & Repair](https://machinematcher.com/servicing-repairs): Professional onsite roll forming machine maintenance and repair services worldwide

## Machine Categories

- [Used Roll Forming Machines](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/used-roll-forming-machines): Used roll forming machines including roof panel, purlin, deck, and gutter machines
- [Roofing & Cladding Machines](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/roofing-cladding-machines): Browse roofing and cladding roll forming machines including PBR and standing seam
- [Structural & Framing Machines](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/structural-framing-machines): Structural framing machines for C & Z purlin, steel stud, and drywall track
- [Decking & Flooring Machines](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/decking-flooring-machines): Metal deck roll forming machines including B deck, N deck, and composite decking
- [Flashing, Trim & Gutter Machines](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/flashing-trim-gutter-machines): Flashing, trim, and gutter roll forming machines including drip edge and ridge cap
- [Door, Window & Shutter Machines](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/door-window-shutter-machines): Door, window, and shutter roll forming machines from global suppliers
- [Renewable Energy Machines](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/renewable-energy-machines): Renewable energy roll forming machines for solar brackets and mounting structures
- [Shelving / Storage Rack Machines](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/shelving-storage-rack-machines): Shelving and storage rack roll forming machines for upright posts and box beams

## Equipment & Reference

- [Coil Handling Equipment](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/coil-handling-equipment): Coil handling equipment including uncoilers, recoilers, and feed lines worldwide
- [Metal Fabrication Machinery](https://machinematcher.com/machine-categories/metal-fabrication-machinery): Metal fabrication machinery including lathes, laser cutters, and press brakes
- [Roll Forming Profile Drawings](https://machinematcher.com/profiles): Roll forming profile catalog with drawings, specifications, and material gauges
